<!-- Title: 🚗 Supported Modded Vehicles & Requests -->

[b]中文版：[/b] [url=https://steamcommunity.com/workshop/filedetails/discussion/3814684002/586187800874015399/]🚗 支援的 MOD 車與申請[/url]

With a tag installed, the mount and the tag show up at the top of the windshield. Every vanilla vehicle is supported; for modded vehicles we first need to know where the windshield is, so only the vehicles below have a matched position.

[h2]❓ What about vehicles not on the list[/h2]
[list]
[*] [b]Everything still works[/b]: every vehicle with a battery takes a tag, and registering, opening gates and charging work the same.
[*] [b]You may just not see it[/b]: the position is estimated from the vehicle size and often ends up behind the windshield, hidden by the glass.
[/list]

[h2]✅ Supported modded vehicles (47 mods)[/h2]
Positions are computed from the vehicle models, using the game's top-down camera angle to stay clear of accessories a vehicle can spawn with (roof light bars, roof racks, sun visors and so on), and every one was checked in a preview render; vehicles marked ✔ were also checked in game. Vehicles from other mods that reuse these bodies (such as expansion packs of the same series) are covered too. Accessories added to a vehicle can hide the tag, for example windshield armor you install yourself.

[h2]📮 Request a vehicle[/h2]
The vehicle must be a Build 42 mod with a battery (trailers and bicycles never take a tag). Any of these works:
[olist]
[*] [b]Reply in this thread[/b] with the vehicle mod's Workshop link and the vehicle name.
[*] [b]GitHub Issue[/b]: use the "Modded vehicle position request" form https://github.com/Minidoracat/MinidoracatKnoxPassFor42/issues/new?template=modcar-request.yml
[*] [b]Discord[/b]: https://discord.gg/Gur2V67
[/olist]
A screenshot from in front of the vehicle with the tag installed helps. If a mod update changes the body and the tag ends up in an odd place, report it the same way.

[h3]What cannot be supported[/h3]
[list]
[*] Windshields that are not centred on the vehicle (such as an armoured vehicle's offset vision slit): the tag can only sit on the centre line and would end up on the body.
[*] Same body, but the tag can't be seen in game (everything still works): '85 Chevrolet Step-Van SWAT (comes with windshield armor fitted), '90 Pierce Arrow Quint Ladder Truck (the ladder sits over the cab and hides the windshield)
[/list]
